content.user_title: Create Structured Product and Design Specs
content.value_statement: Teams need clear specifications before implementation starts. This skill turns feature requirements into PRD, technical, and UX specs with validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of PRD, technical, and UX specification documents.
Enforces the dependency order from app vision to PRD, tech specs, and UX specs.
Uses Markdown templates for required sections and expected document structure.
Runs local validation scripts for dependency and structure checks.
Saves generated specs under the expected specs directory and filenames.
Reports created spec locations and validation results to the user.
limitations: Requires prerequisite specs before creating downstream documents.
Does not implement production code or modify application logic.
Templates are generic and still need project-specific review.
Validation checks document structure, not product correctness.

use_cases.title: Draft a Product Requirements Document
use_cases.description: Turn an existing app vision into a PRD with goals, user stories, scope, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Prepare Technical Planning Docs
use_cases.description: Convert approved product requirements into architecture, data model, API, security, testing, and deployment sections.

use_cases.title: Define UX Specification Details
use_cases.description: Create UX documentation for design principles, screens, responsive behavior, accessibility, and interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Create a PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a product requirements document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PRD for this feature using the specs-creator workflow. Confirm prerequisites, use the PRD template, validate the result, and report the file location.

prompt_templates.title: Create Technical Specs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after a PRD exists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create technical specs from specs/prd.md. Include architecture, data models, APIs, security, testing, deployment, and implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Create UX Specs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after PRD and tech specs exist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create UX specs from specs/prd.md and specs/tech-specs.md. Cover design principles, screens, responsive behavior, accessibility, motion, and dark mode.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Revise Specs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for complete documentation quality control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing PRD, technical specs, and UX specs for dependency order and template compliance. Run validation, revise gaps, and summarize remaining risks.

output_examples.input: Create a PRD for a team analytics dashboard from the app vision.
output_examples.output: A PRD is created with goals, personas, user stories, requirements, scope, success metrics, validation status, and a saved file path.

output_examples.input: Create technical specs after the PRD is approved.
output_examples.output: A technical specification is produced with architecture, data models, API plans, security notes, testing strategy, deployment steps, and validation results.

output_examples.input: Create UX specs for the feature using the PRD and technical specs.
output_examples.output: A UX specification is produced with design principles, screens, component states, responsive guidance, accessibility requirements, and motion rules.

best_practices: Provide an app vision before requesting a PRD.
Review each generated spec before using it for implementation.
Run validation again after manual edits to keep documents consistent.
anti_patterns: Requesting UX specs before PRD and technical specs exist.
Using generated specs as final approval without stakeholder review.
Asking the skill to write production code instead of documentation.

faq.question: What documents can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create PRD, technical specification, and UX specification documents from the required prerequisite files.

faq.question: Does it create the app vision document?
faq.answer: No. It expects specs/app-vision.md to exist before it creates a PRD.

faq.question: Where does it save generated specs?
faq.answer: It saves documents in the specs directory using the filenames defined by the workflow.

faq.question: Can it change application code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to documentation and validation tasks.

faq.question: What validation does it perform?
faq.answer: It checks document dependencies and expected template structure using included local Python scripts.

faq.question: Can I customize the templates?
faq.answer: Yes. Template edits should preserve required sections so validation can still guide the workflow.
